businessGoal: Allow users to filter items by different categories to find relevant content

scenarios.goal: User can successfully filter items by a specified category
User receives an appropriate error message when attempting to filter items by a non-existing category
User can view the correct set of items displayed after applying a filter

outOfScope: User interactions outside of category filtering
Performance of the filter function under heavy load
clarifications: No specific error message requirements detailed in the story
No mention of default state before filtering is applied

manual.reason: The story involves user interaction with filtering options.

api.reason: The story does not mention any API endpoints or data retrieval via API for filtering.

ui.reason: The filtering functionality requires UI interaction and displays results in the browser.
